# Structured Data Extraction

Training a BERT-based model to extract people, organisations, places, events, times, and themes from political documents.

It uses the following files from `datasets_from_demokratibasen/`:

* `datasets_from_demokratibasen/data_collection/entities_themes/extractions-202512/summaries/dataset-202505-dataset-202510-all-tokens-structured-data-202512.json`: generated by `datasets_from_demokratibasen/data_collection/entities_themes/extractions-202512/summarise_extracted_data.py.`
* `datasets_from_demokratibasen/data_collection/entities_themes/extractions-202512/dataset_loader/loader.py`: to load `dataset-202505` and `dataset-202510`.

Subfolders (TBD):

* `training_data/`: extract gold labels and generate training examples
* `entity-extraction-trainer/`: train encoder models to extract people, organisations, places, events and times
* `theme-classification-trainer/`: train encoder models to classify documents according to themes

Create `/training_data`:

* rom `datasets_from_demokratibasen/data_collection/entities_themes/extractions-202512/summaries/dataset-202505-dataset-202510-all-tokens-structured-data-202512.json`, extract:
  * all issues (*hva_saken_gjelder*), topics (*tema*), people (*viktige_personer*), places (*viktige_steder*), organisations (*viktige_personer*), events (*viktige_hendelser*), and times (*viktige_tidspunkter*) into files named `./training_data/extractions/issues.txt`, etc. One issue/topic/person/place/... per line.
* people, organisations, and places do not need further processing
* times need serious cleaning, resulting in pairs of (original_time_string, cleaned_time_string)
* events, issues, and topics must be translated, for events this must result in pairs
